analytics.lead: How people find GEC and how many become students. Website numbers only include visitors who accepted analytics cookies.
analytics.conversion_note: Consenting visitors who sent an enquiry
analytics.funnel_note: Leads created in this period, followed through every step.
analytics.no_utm: No leads with UTM campaign tags yet. Add utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to your ad links.
analytics.privacy_note: First-party analytics: no third-party trackers, no fingerprinting, no IP addresses stored. Visitors who decline cookies are not counted.
analytics.team_lead: Per counsellor, for leads created in this period. “In time” = first contact within {h} hours.

scoring.no_web: No website activity recorded (the visitor did not accept analytics cookies, or came through another channel).
scoring.visits_summary: {pages} pages viewed · first visit {first} · last seen {last}
scoring.scale: Scores are capped between 0 and 100. Counsellors can still set the temperature by hand on a lead.
scoring.privacy: Website signals only exist for visitors who accepted analytics cookies.

rule.source_consultation: Asked for a consultation, called or walked in

campaigns.lead: E-mail, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns to people who agreed to receive updates.
campaigns.none_text: Send news about intakes, scholarships or events to a chosen audience.
campaigns.opens_note: Only counted when the mail app loads images.
campaigns.cancel_confirm: Stop this campaign? Messages already sent cannot be recalled.
campaigns.consent_rule: Only people who gave marketing consent and have not unsubscribed are included — always.
campaigns.save_to_refresh: Save to update the count after changing filters.
campaigns.vars_hint: You can use {{student_name}}, {{first_name}} and {{company_name}}. People get the version in their language. An unsubscribe link is added automatically.
campaigns.cta_hint: Tracking parameters (utm_source=gec, utm_medium, utm_campaign) are added automatically.
campaigns.unsub_auto: Every message includes a working unsubscribe link.
campaigns.launch_help: Leave the date empty to start now, or choose when to start. Sending happens in batches.
campaigns.launch_confirm: Send to {n} people? This cannot be undone.

automations.lead: Rules that act for the team: when something happens and the conditions match, the actions run. New rules start switched off.
automations.none_text: For example: when a lead is created for the UK, assign a UK counsellor and create a call task.
automations.saved_off: Saved. The rule is off until you switch it on.
automations.name_ph: e.g. UK leads → assign and call within 2 hours
automations.delay_hint: For time-based triggers: how long to wait.
automations.if_hint: All conditions must match. Leave empty to run for everyone.
automations.values_text: Use the keys stored in the system, separated by commas: destination codes (uk, usa, canada…), degree (bachelor, master, phd…), temperature (cold, warm, hot), sources (contact_form, consultation, whatsapp…), stage keys:
automations.safety: Actions taken by a rule can start other rules only once more, so rules cannot loop. Time-based rules run once per record. Messages respect each person’s channel and are logged on their timeline.
automations.no_runs: This rule has not run yet.
automations.action_move_lead_stage: Move the lead to a stage
automations.action_add_note: Add a note to the timeline

trigger.lead_enquiry: A known lead sends another enquiry
trigger.lead_stage_changed: A lead moves to another stage
trigger.application_stage_changed: An application moves to another stage
trigger.visa_stage_changed: A visa case moves to another stage
trigger.lead_not_contacted: A lead is not contacted after the delay
trigger.lead_inactive: A lead has no activity for the delay
trigger.application_stuck: An application stays in one stage for the delay

unsub.title: Unsubscribe
unsub.text: Stop receiving news and offers from GEC? We will still send messages about your own applications and appointments.
unsub.done_text: You will not receive marketing messages from us any more.
unsub.not_found_text: This unsubscribe link is not valid. Contact us and we will remove you.
